name: Test Case / Test Result
purpose: Represent immutable reusable test-case revisions, executions, observations, adjudicated results and sealed evidence while referencing requirement, release, defect and environment masters.

owns: test-case identity and immutable definition revisions
preconditions inputs ordered actions expected outcomes oracle tolerances and postconditions
execution attempts pinned to exact definition revision and subject digest
observed outcomes distinct from adjudicated verdicts
sealed execution evidence and result supersession
aggregate governance access retention and provenance
delegates: requirement and acceptance-criterion identity to WM-REC-006
build release and tested-artifact identity to WM-SFT-008
defect triage resolution and closure to WM-SFT-014
test-environment mastership remains unresolved; executions embed an immutable environment pin value
test-defect record mastership remains an explicit out-of-scope gap
excludes: test plan campaign suite or cycle lifecycle
requirement risk release or defect mastership
environment provisioning or configuration baseline ownership

relations.purpose: Resolve immutable requirement and acceptance-criterion revisions.
Resolve exact build or release artifact identity and digest.
Raise reproduce or verify defects without sharing lifecycle state.
Resolve remediation or follow-up work without turning results into tasks.

operations.effect: Issue an immutable definition revision with oracle and exact expected outcomes.
Run one frozen revision against an exact subject digest and environment.
Append raw observed outcomes with method and time.
Compare observations through the declared oracle and record a verdict.
Classify deterministic flaky environment-failure or inconclusive behavior across attempts.
Seal a content-addressed evidence manifest for downstream assurance.

invariants.rule: Every execution pins one immutable test-case revision and matching definition digest; broken bindings are flagged and never repointed.
Expected behavior, oracle and tolerance are separate from executable automation binding and harness revision.
Every result fragment has stable run-scoped identity; suite rollups never replace fragments.
Raw observations are immutable; adjudication supersedes only adjudication state.
Adjudication class is asserted by a named authority and routes only product-defect class toward WM-SFT-014.
Test-defect, environment-failure, inconclusive and not-applicable never create a product defect in this contour.
Every defect link names defectRef, role, authority and time; verified-fixed requires passed product-defect-cleared adjudication.
AttemptSet members have identical definition, parameters, subject and environment-pin digests; set classification never rewrites member verdicts.
Flaky and inconclusive do not mean passed and cannot satisfy VerificationEvidence.
A zero exit code, empty failure list or absent defect link never implies passed.
A run without complete environment evidence records partial or absent completeness and reason and is never called reproducible.
Environment failure is error or blocked, not product failed, unless separately adjudicated with product evidence.
Every execution pins exact WM-SFT-008 subject identity and digest; tags alone are insufficient.
Correcting a definition, oracle, tolerance, harness or adjudication never advances a product-defect lifecycle.
Requirement links pin reference, revision and digest; WM-REC-006 remains an external held target.
Evidence is sealed and content-addressed; disposal retains classified immutable tombstones and never reopens a manifest.
Evidence exports record derivation, omissions and the strictest applicable classification.
Any aggregate reports denominator and non-binary counts; silently dropping blocked, error or inconclusive results is invalid.
Release gates consume VerificationEvidence by reference and never rewrite test history.
No TestResult root, Test Environment ID, replacement parent or test-defect model ID is created here.

holds: WM-ACT-038 parent withdrawn; generic activity parent remains unassigned.
Test Environment remains an OPEN-QUESTION value/mastership gap with no identifier.
Test-defect record mastership remains out of scope and unallocated.
WM-REC-006 full specification and requirement-trace target validation remain unresolved.
Frozen-source pin, citation integrity, artifact identity and clause verification holds remain.
Canonical publication and live verification are held; no new runtime ID.

rules: reproducibilityCompleteness is complete, partial or absent

AttemptSet.guard: at least two members with identical bindings

EvidenceManifest.guard: content replaced by immutable disposal tombstones
